description: Search UK companies on Companies House or fetch full company profiles for specific company numbers.

apiKey.description: Free API key from https://developer.company-information.service.gov.uk. Required for all requests. Registration is free.
apiKey.title: Companies House API Key

companyNumbers.description: List of UK company registration numbers (e.g. ['01234567', '09876543']). Used in getCompanyDetail mode.
companyNumbers.title: Company Numbers (getCompanyDetail mode)

companyStatus.description: Filter results by company status. Leave blank for all statuses.
companyStatus.title: Company Status Filter

companyType.description: Filter results by company type. Leave blank for all types.
companyType.title: Company Type Filter

maxItems.description: Maximum number of company records to return.
maxItems.title: Max Items

mode.description: Operation mode: search companies by name or fetch full detail for specific company numbers.
mode.title: Mode

searchQuery.description: Company name or keywords to search for (e.g. 'technology', 'consulting', 'Amazon').
searchQuery.title: Search Query

title: Companies House Scraper Input
